highlights.eligibility: Recognised academic qualification + English / Italian proficiency

overview: Indian students who are interested in vehicle design, automotive technology, electric vehicles, vehicle dynamics and advanced mobility systems can consider Automobile Engineering in Italy . A Master's in Automobile Engineering in Italy helps students develop specialized Automobile Engineering Skills in vehicle design, automotive systems, electric mobility and vehicle performance.

Italy is an especially attractive destination for automotive studies, due to its established vehicle manufacturing ecosystem and specialist programs in high-performance cars, motorcycles, powertrains and advanced vehicle technologies.

sections.title: Why study Automotive Engineering in Italy?

items: Automotive industry exposure: Italy has internationally recognized automotive and motorsport companies.
Specialized Master's programs: Students can explore advanced automotive engineering, vehicle design, powertrain systems and motorsport engineering.
English-taught options There are a number of relevant postgraduate programs taught in English.
Electric vehicle technology: Explore electric propulsion, hybrid powertrains, energy systems, and sustainable mobility.
Practical learning: Some programs include labs, industry projects, internships, or applied research.
Career opportunities Graduates can pursue international career opportunities in the fields of automotive manufacturing, vehicle testing, research and mobility technology.

sections.title: Courses in Automobile Engineering in Italy

items: The Master's in Automobile Engineering in Italy is typically a 2-year program and can be worth 120 ECTS credits. Course titles vary between institutions so students should also look for courses called Advanced Automotive Engineering, Automotive and Motorsport Engineering and Vehicle Engineering.
Common specializations include:
Automotive design and vehicle development
Engineering of electric and hybrid vehicles
Automotive power trains
Vehicle dynamics and control
Race car engineering and motorsport
Electronics and Mechatronics in Automotive
Connected and autonomous cars
Automobile manufacturing and production
Vehicle aerodynamics & simulation
Sustainable mobility and advanced materials.
Students should carefully compare curricula to choose a program that matches their intended career.

sections.title: Who can study Automobile Engineering in Italy?

items: Indian students seeking admission to Master's program in Automobile Engineering , generally need:
Recognized Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Automobile Engineering, Automotive Engineering, Mechatronics or related discipline.
Suitable academic background in Mathematics, Mechanics, Thermodynamics, Materials, Electronics or Control Systems.
University entry requirements, including academic grades.
English language proficiency Required for English taught programs.
Any other subject credits, tests or academic assessments as required by the University.

Some programs have limited places and selection is competitive. For example, the Advanced Automotive Engineering program at the University of Modena and Reggio Emilia lists curricular prerequisites, a cut-off point for academic performance and B2 level English proficiency. Applicants should not apply based on a general percentage requirement, but should check the current call for admission.

sections.title: Automobile Engineering Admission Process in Italy

items: Select your program: Compare automotive engineering, motorsport engineering, vehicle engineering, and powertrain specialisations.
Eligibility check: Check degree requirements, academic results, language requirements and selection criteria.
Get papers ready: Gather transcripts, diplomas, CV, results of language tests and any other documents that are needed.
Apply online: Apply in the official university portal before the deadline.
Complete the assessment Attend any interview, academic evaluation or selection process that may be necessary.
Verify admission and funding: Follow the university's instructions on how to accept the offer, enroll and apply for scholarships.
Complete the visa formalities: Follow the appropriate student-visa process and see if pre-enrolment through Universitaly is necessary.
For the 2026-2027 intake, please always consult the current program page and the official admission call, as deadlines and requirements might change.

sections.title: Degree in Automobile Engineering - Recognition in Italy

items: A Master's degree in Automobile Engineering or Advanced Automotive Engineering from a recognized Italian university can offer advanced training in vehicle systems, mechanical design, powertrains, manufacturing and mobility technologies.
Students may study vehicle simulation, electric propulsion, automotive electronics, vehicle dynamics and production engineering, depending on the curriculum.

Graduates can look for work in Italy or abroad, depending on the requirements of the employer and the work authorization required. Students wanting to work in India should inquire are any qualification or recognition requirements for that specific role.

faq.question: Is it possible for Indian students to pursue Automobile Engineering in Italy?
faq.answer: Yes. Indian students can apply for eligible Master's programs in Automobile Engineering, Advanced Automotive Engineering, Vehicle Engineering or related subjects subject to meeting the university's academic and language requirements.

faq.question: What is the duration of Master in Automobile Engineering in Italy?
faq.answer: Relevant Master's programs are usually two years long and contain 120 ECTS credits. Students should check the exact length and format of the program they choose.

faq.question: Is the automobile engineering course in Italy in English?
faq.answer: Yes, there are some post graduate programs that are taught in English only. For example, the Advanced Automotive Engineering program at the University of Bologna for the academic year 2026-2027 is listed as a two-year, English taught program.

faq.question: How much is the tuition fee for Automobile Engineering in Italy?
faq.answer: Fees will vary by university, program and student fee category. Check the official tuition schedule and see if you qualify for any scholarships or reductions in fees.

faq.question: What is the scope of Automobile Engineering in Italy?
faq.answer: Graduates can find opportunities in automotive design, electric vehicles, powertrain development, vehicle testing, manufacturing, motorsport and research and development. Job availability depends on technical skills, experience, language ability and work authorization.
